_note: Public list prices in USD per million tokens for the model the note formatter calls. Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing, read on 2026-11-15. Row read: Claude Sonnet 5.5, base input $2, cache hits and refreshes $0.10, 5-minute cache writes $2.50, output $10. The runner prices note-formatting requests only (the ones that report token usage) and does not add the cache-write surcharge, which applies to the first request after the cache expires. The Ask router uses Claude Haiku 5.5 (base input $0.10, cache hits $0.01, output $0.50 for prompts up to 100,000 tokens, same page and date); its cost is not in the per-request figure.
